name: Overcoming Rejection
overview: Scripture reveals that overcoming rejection is rooted in trusting the Lord as our unfailing Shepherd who provides and cares for us even when human relationships fail, as seen in Psalms 23:1 and 27:10. God assures His presence and strength in times of abandonment, encouraging believers not to fear because He upholds and helps them with His righteous hand (Isaiah 41:10, 41:13). His compassionate love is steadfast, never forgetting His people despite their circumstances (Isaiah 49:15), and trusting in Him wholeheartedly replaces reliance on our limited understanding (Proverbs 3:5).
